caption: The drawing depicts a scene in a park dominated by several tall trees with green and brown foliage, set against a blue background. In the foreground, there are multiple paths with people walking, most of whom appear to be women dressed in long light brown dresses, as well as a few men. There is a large building in the center labeled "CASTLE GARDEN" in orange letters. The building has arches and a flat roof, with an American flag flying above it. The ground is light blue-green with scattered patches of darker green and brown, suggesting grass and gardens. The sky is a flat blue, and the composition is enclosed within a square border, centered on an off-white background.
